marco: Deploybot scheduled a soft-enable for model horizon-13b-v2 in eu-west at 23:30 UTC (change window). We're testing the new slot-allocation policy 'tiered-slot' that favors premium routes. Please ACK if ops/QA are ready. Deploybot will start warmup 15m prior and perform prefix warming.

sara: ack — infra oncall, I'll watch telemetry and lookout for OOMs/evictions.

tim: quick question — what's the fallback ordering for this cutover? older 13b or quant variants?

marco: fallback order is explicit in the new priority map: horizon-13b-v1 -> horizon-13b-q -> nimbus-7b. We prefer non-quant v1 as first fallback to preserve quality, quant second for cost-saving fallback.

jess: noted. do we have a pin strategy for critical routes (chat, search)? we should pin to avoid noisy canaries.

marco: yes — we'll apply temporary pins for tier=enterprise routes. Use `catalog pin --route=chat --model=horizon-13b-v2 --duration=30m` for manual pin if needed. Auto-pin list: `/cfg/pinlists/slot-cutover/enterprise.json`.

deploybot: deploybot: enable plan created by @marco. Command to apply:
```
deploybot enable --model=horizon-13b-v2 --policy=tiered-slot --regions=eu-west --warmup=15m
```
Will perform staggered slot allocations across pools. Rollback triggers set: error_rate > 2% for 10m OR latency_p95 > 1.2s. If trigger hit, system will pin previous variant and drain new slots.

olivia: will the new slot policy change per-GPU slot counts? we saw density regressions last time.

marco: yes it'll prefer fewer high-priority slots on same GPU for premium traffic. Default per-GPU slot cap remains 8; if we see memory pressure ops can set `slot_cap=6` per-pool.

tim: add this to rollback plan: immediate scale-down to 0.5qps per-slot for affected routes + pin to v1 while we investigate.

ron: I'll own rollback during the window. If deploybot triggers automatic rollback I'll follow the runbook and coordinate support.

infra-bot: alert rule created: `model_cutover_eu_horizon_13b_v2_errors` -> notify #eng-oncall and #product if >1% errors over 5m; runbook: /runbooks/model-cutover.md

sara: small heads-up — telemetry gating is enabled. Please avoid simultaneous non-related deploys in eu-west 23:00-00:30 UTC.

jess: QA will run the smoke prompt set (smoke/horizon-13b-v2) at +20m after enable. Will report eval deltas in this thread.

marco: thanks everyone. Plan: warmup 23:15, staged slot allocation 23:30-23:45, monitor for 30m. If all green we'll open full route by midnight. Keep channel open and ping me @marco for any manual rollback. :rocket:

deploybot: scheduled enable approved and queued by @marco. Starting warmup actions at 23:15 UTC. Logs will stream to /logs/deploys/4750001234.

olivia: ack — will be watching memory and eviction metrics.

tim: ack — standing by for rollback.

marco: closing ops handshake. If no objections by 23:10 proceed. :white_check_mark:
